resources.string: Red Button
Allows Red Button to request a factory reset through Android DevicePolicyManager after explicit one-time arming in the application. Granting administrator rights alone never wipes the device.

Critical Android Limitation

No Android version or app can guarantee that a reset will be accepted, completed, or erase all data from every storage medium. Red Button can only ask Android to run an official DevicePolicyManager operation in a qualified configuration. It is NOT a guaranteed or certified wipe, does NOT detect theft, and does NOT work remotely or in the background.

Android API is below 23 (unsupported).
Red Button does not have an active Device Admin / Owner wipe policy.
On API 23, full wipe is accepted only for Device Owner because system user cannot be reliably verified via public read.
Ordinary Profile Owner on API 24–33 cannot perform a full device wipe.

Open Android Device Admin Activation

Granting Device Admin in Android Settings is a separate system step and never triggers a wipe by itself. Note: On API 34+, standard Device Admin is insufficient; Android Enterprise Device Owner / Org-Owned Profile Owner provisioning is required.

Execution Mode & Options
Enable TEST MODE (Simulation)
When enabled, the next launch after arming only simulates evaluation and NEVER calls wipeData() or wipeDevice().
Request WIPE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
Default ON when supported. Public Android API does not confirm which removable SD cards or adopted storage volumes the OS/OEM will actually erase.
Request WIPE_EUICC (Erase eSIM profiles)
Opt-in only on supported API 34+ configurations with eUICC hardware. Below API 28, eSIM capability is reported as unknown.
WIPE_RESET_PROTECTION_DATA (FRP clear) and WIPE_SILENTLY are strictly forbidden and never requested.
Informed Consent Before Arming

• Next launch triggers automatically: The very next start of Red Button — whether opened by you or, if Android permits, by another app or system component — will automatically consume this consent and trigger the action without a second confirmation screen.
• No launch authentication or theft detection: The app cannot identify who opened it, does not detect theft, does not locate the device, and does not run remotely.
• Irreversible data loss: An accepted production reset request may permanently erase local data on the device.
• No guarantee of acceptance or erasure: Android or the OEM may reject the request, fail to complete it, or leave residual data on flash media.
• External storage uncertainty: WIPE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is requested when supported, but actual coverage of removable or adopted media depends on Android/OEM.
• eSIM & FRP: Removing eSIM requires explicit opt-in on API 34+; Factory Reset Protection (FRP) is NEVER cleared by this app.

• No in-app cancel screen after arming: Once armed, reopening Red Button executes the action. The only way to disarm before the next launch is clearing app storage in Android Settings (which may be blocked by administrator policy).
